title: POL-599: support console usage policy
body:
## Scope

Policy POL-599 covers the Support Console and is in draft, per the policy register. The policy owner
is Hana Kowalski (Release Management); yearly audits against the controls listed here are run by
Bluegate Networks.

## Requirements

As of the 5 June 2025 review the requirements are:
* Keep production data out of test and development environments
* Complete the annual security training before the published deadline
* Patch critical vulnerabilities within fourteen days of publication

## Status

The policy is out for comment according to the register. Felix Brandt issued this version on 13 July
2025, with 19 exceptions on file that expire at the yearly audit.
